scoring_rule.rule: Support-weighted absolute category positive-rate deviation from overall positive rate; all categories included, with support counts
Uncorrected Cramers V for prefix-order versus label, including other; undefined if only one order/class
Absolute Pearson r of total raw characters in both texts versus label; signed r and class counts recorded; undefined for constant inputs
Fraction of pairs containing at least one frequent shortcut token as defined above; token phi and supports reported
5 * rows not in contradictory normalized pair groups / eligible rows; any unresolved contradiction independently blocks training

label_metadata_consistency.evidence: Original metadata validated before derivation; eligible label counts checked against cohort, never pair_type

scoring_rule.rule: 5 * eligible labels covered by verified cohort and original metadata provenance / eligible rows; pair_type never supplies label

schema_completeness.evidence: Every eligible record passes strict source schema; invalid sources are rejected

scoring_rule.rule: 5 * valid eligible rows / eligible rows; loader rejects invalid sources
Duplicate extras divided by eligible pairs; linearly decrease 5 to 0 from rate 0 to .05
5 * required exact base categories present / 5; compound categories reported separately
5 for positive fraction in [.4,.6]; linear to 0 at 0 or 1
5 * required pair types present / 9

unique_profiles.evidence: Unique normalized profile ratio; occurrences retained

scoring_rule.rule: 5 * unique normalized profiles / 2N profile occurrences
5 * human acceptable / 20 sampled fit pairs
5 * human acceptable / 20 sampled fit pairs

evidence.definition: First three normalized word tokens after removing boy:/girl:; largest scaffold frequency across profile occurrences.

scoring_rule.rule: Largest normalized opening-template share among 2N profile occurrences
5 * profiles without blank/control/replacement text, fewer than 5 alpha characters, runs >=10, or explicit truncation markers / 2N; imperfect surface diagnostic, not model-token truncation
5 * human clear and noncontradictory judgments / 20; ambiguous counts zero
5 * human acceptable stated preference hierarchy consistency / 20
5 * human acceptable label agreement / 20
5 * human acceptable preference realism / 20
